correctness.rationale: The cubic B-spline convolution of four explicit uniform laws yields a unique three-dimensional spectral radius density. Compact-support moment determinacy proves both two-step dimension walks. The resulting exact seven-dimensional density is nonnegative exactly up to the inclusive quadratic cutoff, strictly negative on an interval beyond it, and has an upward jump at its interior knot for all parameters; double Abel inversion excludes an eighth-dimensional positive lift. The five-dimensional lower bound follows from the known squared-sinc Schoenberg theorem and the Schur product theorem. A standalone symbolic checker verifies the exact chamber identities, zero and second moment, critical sign and jump; no infinite proof is inferred from probes.

value.rationale: An exact two-parameter isotropy index for the first natural product of two five-dimensional squared spherical characteristic functions, with a sharp nonobvious algebraic separation threshold, admissible boundary, strictness, and a universal obstruction to dimension eight. This resolves a nontrivial structural variation of classic Schoenberg-product behavior rather than merely recomputing a known scale.
